items.t: Enzyme kinetics: Michaelis-Menten mechanics, Lineweaver-Burk analysis and reversible inhibition
items.c: Lineweaver-Burk plot: competitive inhibitors increase Km (same Vmax, same Y-intercept); non-competitive inhibitors decrease Vmax (same Km, same X-intercept).
items.a: Lineweaver-Burk double reciprocal plot showing 1/V versus 1/[S]. Competitive inhibition line intersects at identical Y-intercept (same 1/Vmax) with X-intercept shifted rightward towards origin (increased Km). Non-competitive inhibition line shares identical X-intercept (same -1/Km) with higher Y-intercept (reduced Vmax).

items.a: Metabolic pathway map connecting cytoplasmic glycolysis to mitochondrial respiration. Glucose converts to 2 pyruvate yielding 2 ATP and 2 NADH. Pyruvate dehydrogenase decarboxylates pyruvate to Acetyl-CoA. Krebs citric acid cycle produces 3 NADH, 1 FADH2, and 1 GTP per turn, fueling oxidative phosphorylation to produce 30 to 32 ATP.
